mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to a journey that might just change the way you think about money—maybe even your life. Have you ever wondered why some people seem to build wealth effortlessly, while others struggle, no matter how hard they work? Together, we're about to explore the lessons woven into Rich Dad, Poor Dad by Robert T. Kiyosaki—a book that dives deep into the ways early financial education and family beliefs shape everything we do with money. Imagine growing up with two father figures. One tells you to study hard, get good grades, and find a secure job. The other encourages you to think for yourself, seek out opportunities, and learn how money really works. As we move through their stories, you'll see how these two powerful voices create a push-and-pull between playing it safe and daring to dream bigger. You'll hear real-life examples, pick up practical wisdom, and be challenged to question everything you thought you knew about earning, investing, and building true wealth. The big idea? It's not just about working for money—it's about making your money work for you. So, if you're ready to challenge old habits, open up to new possibilities, and maybe even rethink what it means to be rich, let's dive in together. This is more than a book—it's an invitation to financial freedom, and I'm excited to explore it with you.
